scope: Persist the NEW_VIDEO fan-out intent atomically with immediate publication; retry delivery from the existing durable job runner.
implementation: Immediate publish and premiere-to-live paths now enqueue NEW_VIDEO_FANOUT inside the same database transaction as their PUBLISHED/live state and audit update.
Only the low-latency runner kick happens after commit. If the kick or request process is lost, the existing cron runner can recover the pending job.
The durable enqueue retains its unique (kind, videoId) key, reopens DONE/DEAD jobs for an explicit republish and relies on per-user idempotence in the existing fan-out handler.
The transaction-scoped enqueue throws on persistence failure so the publication state and its announcement intent roll back together.

checks.name: cron-route-wiring
covers: Unauthorized route calls do not invoke any job runner
Every authorized route tick calls durable NEW_VIDEO_FANOUT runner
Runner failure returns HTTP 500 and does not falsely complete later cron work

checks.name: postgres-transaction-and-runner-recovery
covers: repeat enqueue in one publication transaction leaves one unique intent
commit leaves a PENDING intent without calling the request-side kick; the durable runner then claims and completes it
a transaction failure rolls both PUBLISHED state and the durable intent back

limits: The PostgreSQL case tests the real transaction helper, durable runner and rows but does not kill a live web process or execute the cron HTTP route after restart.
Fan-out in this package is in-app notification delivery. No email provider is involved and no exactly-once provider delivery is claimed.
No independent review or server acceptance has been completed; K23 remains open.
handoff: Claude: on non-production, confirm both publish entry points leave one pending NEW_VIDEO_FANOUT row in the same commit, then suppress the immediate runner kick/restart the request process and verify the scheduled premiere-notifications cron claims and completes it. Re-publish/retry and confirm the unique job plus per-user dedupe prevents duplicate in-app rows. Do not claim exactly-once external email delivery.
